home.title: Masewera ndi Zochita za Dementia ndi Alzheimer's | Golden Moments
home.description: Masewera aulere, ofatsa a zithunzi oti musewere pa intaneti ndi malingaliro a zochita kwa anthu okhala ndi dementia kapena Alzheimer's ndi osamalira awo. Palibe kulembetsa, palibe nthawi kapena mapointi.
home.eyebrow: Yaulere · Palibe malonda · Palibe kulembetsa · Palibe nthawi kapena mapointi
home.h1: Masewera ndi Zochita Zofatsa kwa Anthu Okhala ndi Dementia
home.lede: Masewera osavuta a zithunzi, zithunzi zodziwika bwino, ndi zochita zosangalalira limodzi, pa liwiro lanu.
facts: Imagwira ntchito pa foni, piritsi ndi kompyuta
Imani nthawi iliyonse; palibe chimene chingalephereke
home.heroApp: Komanso pulogalamu yaulere ya iPhone, iPad ndi Android, ndi zithunzi za banja lanu
home.albumNote: “Zithunzi ziwiri za kapu ya tiyi, pamodzi.”
home.gamesLede: Lililonse ndi lodekha, la akulu, ndipo ndi losavuta kuyamba. Sankhani limodzi, khalani pafupi, ndipo mugwirizane kugunda pa zithunzi.

steps.title: Sankhani chinthu chodziwika
steps.text: Zithunzi za makapu a tiyi, minda, ziweto ndi mabwato oyenda panyanja. Palibe kuwerenga kapena malamulo oti muphunzire poyamba.

steps.title: Khalani pafupi pafupi
steps.text: Lolani wina agwire pazithunzi. Lankhulani za zithunzizo. Chithunzi chosagwirizana chimangodikira kugunda kotsatira.

steps.title: Imani pamene zikumveka bwino
steps.text: Masewera amodzi ndi zochita zonse. “Zokwanira pakali pano” imakhalapo nthawi zonse pazenera.

home.stageTitle: Malingaliro a zochita pa gawo lililonse
home.stageLede: Nyimbo, ntchito za tsiku ndi tsiku, kukumbukira zakale ndi nthawi zabata zamaganizo, zosinthidwa malinga ndi zomwe zimamveka bwino pano.

stages.title: Gawo loyamba
stages.text: Pitirizani kuchita zomwe amakonda, ndi kusintha pang'ono: zosangalatsa, maulendo, masewera a mawu ndi kukonzekera limodzi.
stages.label: Malingaliro a gawo loyamba

stages.title: Gawo lapakati
stages.text: Ntchito zosavuta komanso zodziwika bwino zogawidwa m'magawo: kupinda, kusanja, nyimbo, masewera a zithunzi ndi maulendo afupi oyenda.
stages.label: Malingaliro a gawo lapakati

stages.title: Gawo lomaliza
stages.text: Chitonthozo ndi kulumikizana kudzera mukhudzo, phokoso ndi kuona: kusamalira manja, nyimbo zomwe amakonda, zithunzi ndi kukhala limodzi.
stages.label: Malingaliro a gawo lomaliza

home.specificHtml: Mukufuna chinachake chapadera? Yesani zochita ndi masewera a Alzheimer's, masewera ofatsa okumbukira, mafunso osavuta kapena zithunzithunzi.
home.approachTitle: Chochita chogawana, osati mayeso a kukumbukira
home.approachLede: Masewera ambiri a “ubongo” amamangidwa pa liwiro, mapointi ndi mizere yopambana. Kwa munthu wokhala ndi dementia, zimenezo zingamveke ngati mayeso. Ife tapanga mosiyana.

principles.title: Palibe chimene chingalephereke
principles.text: Palibe nthawi, mapointi, miyoyo kapena kugonja. Chithunzi china si cholakwika; ndi kaima kakang'ono.

principles.title: Zithunzi zimakhalabe zoonekera
principles.text: Kuzindikira m'malo mokumbukira. Kufananiza kumayambira zithunzi zikuyang'ana kumwamba, kotero palibe chimene chiyenera kukumbukiridwa.

principles.title: Wa akulu ndi wolemekezeka
principles.text: Mawu ofunda, osavuta ndi zithunzi za moyo weniweni. Osati zojambula za ana kapena kulankhula ngati mwana.

principles.title: Zachinsinsi mwa kapangidwe
principles.text: Palibe maakaunti kapena malonda. Zithunzi zanu sizichoka pa chipangizo chanu.

home.guidesTitle: Malangizo othandiza pa chisamaliro cha tsiku ndi tsiku

guides.title: Momwe mungasewerere masewera limodzi
guides.text: Kukonzekera, liwiro, ndi zochita pamene masewera asiya kusangalatsa.

guides.title: Akakana kuchita zochita
guides.text: Zifukwa zofala zokanira, ndi njira zofatsa zoyesera kachiwiri pambuyo pake.

guides.title: Kukhazikitsa piritsi
guides.text: Malemba akulu, zosokoneza zochepa ndi tsamba limodzi lapanyumba losavuta.

guides.title: Zochita zaulere zosindikizika
guides.text: Mafunso a mawu akulu, masamba ojambula, bingo ndi makhadi okambirana.

home.researchTitle: Thanzi la ubongo: kafukufuku akunena chiyani kwenikweni
home.researchText: Kodi dementia ingalephereke? Kodi masewera a ubongo amathandiza? Nanga kusala kudya, zakudya, tulo ndi kumva? Mayankho omveka bwino, ndi magwero, kuphatikizapo kumene umboni ndi wofooka.
home.appTitle: Golden Moments pa iPhone, iPad ndi Android
home.appText: Pulogalamu yaulere imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti ndipo ingagwiritse ntchito zithunzi za banja zomwe mwasankha, zosungidwa ngati makope pa chipangizo chanu. Mapangidwe omwewo odekha: matailosi anayi akulu, palibe nthawi, palibe mapointi.

faq.q: Ndi masewera ati abwino kwa anthu okhala ndi dementia?
faq.a: Masewera abwino ndi osavuta, odziwika bwino komanso opanda kukakamizidwa: zithunzi zazikulu zofananitsa, kusanja, zithunzi zosavuta kumanga, kumaliza mawu odziwika, kujambula mitundu, bingo ya zithunzi ndi makadi okambirana. Chisankho chabwino ndi chimene munthuyo amakonda lero. Pewani nthawi yoyezera, zigoli ndi chilichonse chomwe chingaoneke ngati mayeso.

faq.q: Kodi masewera a dementia ndi aulere?
faq.a: Inde. Masewera ndi zosindikizira zonse za Golden Moments ndi zaulere, popanda akaunti, kulembetsa kapena kutsitsa. Masewerawa amayenda pa msakatuli wa foni, piritsi kapena kompyuta.

faq.q: Kodi masewera a ubongo amaletsa dementia?
faq.a: Palibe masewera omwe asonyezedwa kuti amaletsa dementia, ndipo Golden Moments sinena kuti imachiritsa kapena kuletsa chilichonse. Masewera athu ndi osangalatsa komanso kuti mukhale limodzi nthawi. Gawo lathu la thanzi la ubongo likufotokoza zomwe kafukufuku amasonyeza ndi zomwe sanasonyeze.

faq.q: Kodi masewerawa ndi oyenera munthu wa Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Inde. Matenda a Alzheimer's ndi omwe amayambitsa dementia kwambiri, ndipo masewerawa anapangidwa poganizira zimenezi: zithunzi zazikulu zomwe zimakhalabe zoonekera, zosankha zochepa, ndipo palibe chokumbukira kapena cholakwika. Kufananitsa, kusanja ndi kumaliza mawu odziwika zimadalira chidziwitso chakale, osati kuphunzira zatsopano.

faq.q: Kodi munthu wa dementia ya gawo lakumapeto angagwiritse ntchito zochitazi?
faq.a: Nthawi zambiri inde, ngati wina ali naye pafupi. Yambani ndi Pezani chimodzimodzi ndi zithunzi ziwiri, Zithunzi zofanana ndi matailosi anayi, pepala lojambula mitundu kapena kupuma pang'ono mwakachetechete. Sungani nthawi yochepa, tsatirani zomwe akufuna ndipo siyani akakhala atakwanira.

Tsambali lilibe maakaunti ndipo lilibe malonda. Timagwiritsa ntchito Google Analytics kuti timvetse masamba omwe amayendera. Zithunzi zomwe mwasankha pa Zithunzi zofanana zimaonetsedwa mu msakatuli wanu kokha ndipo sizikwezedwa.

Golden Moments ndi gulu laling'ono lomwe limapanga zochitika zodekha za zithunzi za akulu kwa mabanja ndi osamalira, pa webusaiti komanso ngati pulogalamu yaulere. Ife si madokotala, ndipo palibe chomwe chili pano ndi upangiri wa zachipatala.

playCta.text: Zithunzi zazikulu, palibe nthawi yoyezera, palibe zigoli ndipo palibe chomwe muyenera kulembetsa. Sewerani pamodzi pa msakatuli wanu.

appCta.title: Tengani masewerawa nanu
appCta.text: Pulogalamu yaulere ya Golden Moments ya iPhone, iPad ndi Android: matailosi azithunzi akulu, masewera ndi zithunzi zanu za banja, ndi mapaketi a zithunzi omwe amagwira ntchito popanda Wi‑Fi. Palibe akaunti, malonda, nthawi kapena zigoli.

activities.label: Zochita
activities.title: Zochita za Anthu Omwe Ali ndi Dementia
activities.seo: Zochita za Anthu Omwe Ali ndi Dementia: Malingaliro Malinga ndi Gawo
activities.description: Malingaliro a zochita kwa anthu omwe ali ndi dementia m'magawo onse: nyimbo, kukumbukira zakale, ntchito za tsiku ndi tsiku, zomverera, zaluso, kukhala panja ndi zosindikizira zaulere.
activities.lede: Chochita chofunika ndi chilichonse chobweretsa chitonthozo, cholinga kapena nthawi yolumikizana. Yambani ndi zomwe munthuyo wakhala akukonda nthawi zonse, ndipo zisinthireni ku momwe alili lero.

caregiving.label: Kusamalira
caregiving.title: Malangizo a Osamalira
caregiving.seo: Malangizo a Osamalira Dementia: Thandizo Lothandiza Tsiku ndi Tsiku
caregiving.description: Malangizo othandiza komanso achifundo kwa osamalira a dementia: kusewera masewera pamodzi, kulankhulana, kukana kuchita zinthu, kusakhazikika madzulo, mapiritsi, kusankha mapulogalamu ndi kudzisamalira.
caregiving.lede: Thandizo lomveka komanso lothandiza pa nthawi za tsiku ndi tsiku posamalira munthu wa dementia, kuphatikizapo kudzisamalira nokha.

brain-health.label: Thanzi la ubongo
brain-health.title: Thanzi la Ubongo: Zomwe Kafukufuku Akunena
brain-health.seo: Thanzi la Ubongo ndi Chiopsezo cha Dementia: Zomwe Kafukufuku Akunena
brain-health.description: Kodi dementia ingapewedwe? Malangizo owona, ozikidwa pa magwero, okhudza zinthu zomwe zimawonjezera chiopsezo cha dementia, masewera a ubongo, kusala kudya, zakudya, masewera olimbitsa thupi, kugona, kumva ndi zizindikiro zoyambirira.
brain-health.lede: Zomwe maphunziro akuluakulu amasonyeza za kuchepetsa chiopsezo cha dementia, zofotokozedwa momveka, kuphatikizapo komwe umboni ndi wofooka kapena wosakhazikika. Ndi chidziwitso chambiri, osati upangiri wa zachipatala.

guide.byTeam: Lolembedwa ndi gulu la Golden Moments
guide.sourcesNote: Timalumikiza ku mabungwe ndi maphunziro omwe tsamba ili likudalira. Chilichonse chinayesedwa tsamba likasinthidwa.

healthNotice.title: Chidziwitso chambiri, osati upangiri wa zachipatala
healthNotice.textHtml: Tsambali likufotokoza mwachidule kafukufuku wofalitsidwa kwa mabanja. Silingakuuzeni chomwe chili choyenera kwa munthu mmodzi. Lankhulani ndi dokotala musanasinthe zakudya, masewera olimbitsa thupi, kugona, mankhwala kapena zowonjezera. Ngati pachitika chisokonezo chadzidzidzi kapena kusintha kwina kwadzidzidzi, pezani thandizo lachipatala nthawi yomweyo. Werengani chidziwitso chathu cha thanzi.

about.title: Zochitika Pamodzi, Osati Mayeso a Kukumbukira
about.description: Chifukwa chake masewera a Golden Moments alibe nthawi yoyezera, zigoli kapena mizere yopambana, chifukwa chake zithunzi zimakhalabe zoonekera, ndi zomwe sitinena za dementia komanso zomwe sitingalonjeze.
about.lede: Golden Moments imapanga zochitika zodekha za zithunzi za akulu zomwe wosamalira ndi munthu wa dementia angasangalale nazo pambali pake.
about.bodyHtml:
Zomwe timakhulupirira

Cholinga chenicheni cha zochitika ndi nthawi yomwe mukukhala limodziyo: kucheza, kumwetulira, kusangalala pofananiza zithunzi ziwiri, kapena kungokhala pafupi limodzi. Sikuyesa munthu aliyense, kumukakamiza kupitilira muyeso, kapena kutsimikizira chilichonse.

Mapulogalamu ambiri olimbitsa ubongo amapangidwa kuti azitsata liwiro, mapointi, kupambana motsatizana komanso magawo a masewera. Kwa munthu amene akukhala ndi vuto la kuiwala (dementia), zimenezi zikhoza kuoneka ngati mayeso omwe sangathe kuwapambana. Ifeyo tinapanga zosiyana kwambiri ndi zimenezo, ndipo timatsatira malamulo awa:

  • Palibe cholephera. Palibe wotchi, mapointi, kuwerengera mayendedwe, miyoyo yamwayi, zokondwerera kapena kuwerengera nthawi yotsala, pazenera lililonse.
  • Kuzindikira m'malo mokumbukira molimbikira. Zithunzi zimakhala zikuonekera nthawi zonse. Mafunso ndi olimbikitsa kukambirana ndipo sayesa mayina kapena zokumbukira za munthu.
  • Zazikulu, zosavuta komanso zosasunthasuntha. Malemba ndi zithunzi zazikulu, zoonekera bwino, ndipo mabatani amakhala pamalo amodzi osasuntha.
  • Ulemu wachikulire. Zithunzi zenizeni za m'moyo ndi mawu odekha, aulemu komanso olankhulidwa mwachibadwa. Palibe zithunzi zoseketsa za ana, zolimbikitsa ngati nyimbo za ana kapena mphoto za zizindikiro za emoji.
  • Kutuluka mosavuta. Mawu akuti “Tasiya pamenepa panopa” amaonekera nthawi zonse. Kusiya panjira ndi zotsatira zabwino zomwe zilibe vuto lililonse.
  • Chinsinsi chotetezedwa nthawi zonse. Palibe akaunti kapena zotsatsa malonda. Zithunzi zomwe mumasankha zimangosala pa chipangizo chanu.

Zomwe sitinena kapena kulonjeza

Masewera athu ndi osangalala komanso ochezera limodzi. Sazindikira, kuyesa, kuyeza, kuchiza, kuchedwetsa kapena kupewa vuto la dementia kapena matenda a Alzheimer, ndipo palibe amene ayenera kuwasankha pa chifukwa chimenecho. Tikamalemba za kafukufuku pamasamba athu a umoyo wa ubongo, timanena mosapita m'mbali pamene umboni uli wosakwanira, ndipo sitilumikiza zimenezo ndi masewera athu ayi.

Ndife ndani

Golden Moments ndi gulu laling'ono lodziimira palokha. Ndife osati madotolo kapena asing'anga. Malangizo athu alembedwa motsatira malangizo ofalitsidwa ndi mabungwe monga National Institute on Aging ndi Alzheimer’s Association, ndipo kalozera aliyense amalemba komwe kumatengedwa uthengawo. Werengani momwe timalembera ndi kuunika masamba athu.

Tiuzeni zomwe zingakuthandizeni

Tingakonde kumva zomwe zikukuyenderani bwino komanso zomwe sizikuyenda, makamaka kuchokera kwa anthu okhala ndi vuto la dementia, achibale omwe akusamalira komanso ogwira ntchito zotsogolera zochitika. Lembani imelo ku {email}.

editorial.title: Momwe Timalembera ndi Kuunika Masamba Athu
editorial.description: Momwe Golden Moments imafufuzira, kulemba, kupeza magwero a nkhani ndi kukonzanso masamba ake okhudza zochitika za dementia ndi umoyo wa ubongo, komanso zomwe sitidzafalitsa konse.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Magwero athu a nkhani

Malangizo athu timawazikira pa chitsogozo chochokera ku mabungwe monga National Institute on Aging, CDC, Alzheimer’s Association, Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, Family Caregiver Alliance ndi NHS, komanso pa kafukufuku wounikidwa ndi asayansi ena monga maumboni a Cochrane ndi mayesero aakulu azachipatala. Kalozera aliyense amatchula magwero omwe adalirapo. Timawerenga gwero lililonse tisanatchule, ndipo timangolemba zomwe limanena zenizeni.

Momwe timalembera

  • Zothandiza poyamba: zomwe mungachite lero, m'chinenero chosavuta kumva.
  • Oona mtima pa za umboni: timagwiritsa ntchito mawu akuti “zimagwirizana ndi”, “zingathe” komanso “umboni uli wosiyanasiyana” ngati zimenezo zili zoona.
  • Mwaulemu: timalemba za anthu okhala ndi vuto la dementia monga akuluakulu, ndipo sitigwiritsa ntchito mawu owafunsa ngati mayeso kapena kuwachititsa manyazi.
  • Palibe zopeka: palibe ziwerengero zopeka, mawu obwereza osatsimikizika, akatswiri oyesera, maphunziro kapena maumboni achinyengo.

Amene amaunika masamba athu

Masamba amalemba ndi kuunikidwa ndi gulu la Golden Moments, mothandizidwa ndi zida za nzeru zopangapanga (AI) pa kafukufuku ndi zolemba zoyambirira. Tsamba lililonse limaunikidwa ndi gululi poyerekeza ndi magwero ake. Masamba athu sanaunikidwe ndi dotolo kapena katswiri wazachipatala, ndipo sitinena kuti aunikidwa. Ndi chidziwitso chonse chabe, osati upangiri wamankhwala.

Zomwe sitidzafalitsa konse

  • Mawu osonyeza kuti masewera, chakudya, mankhwala owonjezera m'thupi, kusaidya kapena chizolowezi chimalepheretsa, kuchiza, kuchedwetsa kapena kuthetsa dementia.
  • Mayeso, mafunso kapena mapointi osonyeza kuti munthu ali ndi dementia kapena alibe.
  • Upangiri woyamba, kusiya kapena kusintha mankhwala aliwonse.
  • Zotsatsa malonda kapena nkhani zolipiridwa zobisika ngati malangizo othandiza.

Zowonjezedwa ndi zowongoleredwa

Tsamba lililonse limasonyeza tsiku lomwe linalikonzedwanso komaliza. Mukapeza cholakwika kapena nkhani yachikale, chonde lemberani imelo ku {email} ndipo tiziunika mwachangu.

faq.title: Mafunso ndi Mayankho
faq.seoTitle: Masewera ndi Zochitika za Dementia: Mafunso ndi Mayankho
faq.description: Mayankho a mafunso omwe amafunsidwa kawirikawiri okhudza masewera ndi zochitika za anthu okhala ndi dementia: masewera oyenera kuyesa, nthawi yosewera, malingaliro a m'magawo apamwamba, umoyo wa ubongo komanso chitetezo cha chinsinsi.
faq.lede: Mayankho achidule komanso omveka bwino pa mafunso omwe anthu osamalira amafunsa kwambiri.

items.q: Kodi ndi masewera ati abwino kwambiri kwa munthu amene ali ndi vuto la kuiwala (dementia)?
items.a: Masewera abwino kwambiri ndi omwe ali ozolowereka, osavuta komanso opanda zokakamiza zilizonse, ndipo masewera abwino ndi chilichonse chomwe munthuyo akusangalala nacho lero. Kufananiza zithunzi zomwe zikuonekera kale, kusanja zinthu, masewera osavuta olumikiza zidutswa za zithunzi (jigsaws), kumaliza miyambi yodziwika bwino, kupenta ndi masewera a bingo a zithunzi zimagwira ntchito bwino kwa anthu ambiri. Pewani mawotchi owerengera nthawi, mapointi ndi chilichonse chimene chikuoneka ngati mayeso.
Inde. Masewera onse ndi zinthu zosindikiza ndi zaulere, popanda kufunika kukhala ndi akaunti, kulembetsa, kutsitsa kapena zotsatsa.

items.q: N’chifukwa chiyani kulibe zigoli, magawo kapena mawotchi owerengera nthawi?
items.a: Kuthamangira nthawi ndi zigoli zimasandutsa masewera osangalatsa kukhala ngati mayeso, zomwe zitha kubweretsa manyazi kapena kukhumudwa. Cholinga chathu ndi kusangalala komanso kucheza limodzi, kotero palibe cholephera ndipo mutha kusiya nthawi iliyonse imene mukufuna.

items.q: Kodi ndi zipangizo ziti zomwe zimagwira bwino ntchito?
items.a: Foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta iliyonse yomwe ili ndi pulogalamu yatsopano yofufuzira pa intaneti. Tabuleti yoikidwa pa tebulo nthawi zambiri imakhala yabwino kwambiri kuti anthu awiri azisewera atakhala limodzi mbali ndi mbali. Laputopu yolumikizidwa pa wailesi yakanema imagwira bwino ntchito kwa magulu.

items.q: Kodi titha kusewera pogwiritsa ntchito zithunzi za banja lathu?
items.a: Inde. Masewera a Photo pairs amagwiritsa ntchito zithunzi 2 mpaka 6 zomwe mwasankha kukhala masewera ofananitsa zithunzi. Zithunzizi zimangokhala pa pulogalamu yanu yofufuzira pa intaneti ndipo sizitumizidwa kapena kusungidwa kwina kulikonse.

items.q: Kodi zochita zizitenga nthawi yaitali bwanji?
items.a: Nthawi zambiri mphindi 10 mpaka 20 ndi zokwanira, ndipo nthawi zina ngakhale mphindi 2 zimakhala zopambana. Yang'anani zizindikiro zotopa kapena kukhumudwa ndipo lekani pamene zidakali zosangalatsa. Palibe nthawi yeniyeni yoyikidwa.

items.q: Bwanji ngati sakufuna kutengapo mbali pa zochitazo?
items.a: Lemekezani kukana kwawo, ndipo yesaninso nthawi ina kapena munjira ina. Kukana kutha kubwera chifukwa chotopa, kupwetekedwa m’thupi, kusadzidalira kapena kusakhala ndi chidwi. Onani kalozera wathu wonena za zomwe mungachite ngati akana.

items.q: Kodi ndi zochita ziti zomwe zili zoyenera pa vuto la dementia lomwe lapita patsogolo?
items.a: Zinthu zotonthoza komanso zokhudza mphamvu zam’thupi: kumvetsera nyimbo zomwe amazikonda, kuwasisita m’manja ndi mafuta, kuyang’anira limodzi zithunzi, kukhala ndi bulangeti lofewa, kukhala panja, kapena masewera osavuta a zithunzi munthu wina atakhala nawo pafupi. Kalozera wathu wa zochita za dementia yapamwamba ali ndi malingaliro enanso ambiri.

items.q: Kodi pali zochita za magulu m’nyumba zosamalira anthu?
items.a: Inde. Picture bingo ili ndi makhadi osindikiza komanso zowerengera pa sikirini, ndipo Finish the saying ndi Conversation cards zimagwira bwino ntchito powerenga mokweza. Kalozera wathu wa magulu a m’nyumba zosamalira anthu akufotokoza za kukula kwa gulu, makhalidwe a mipando komanso kusintha zinthu kuti zikwanire anthu a maluso osiyanasiyana.

items.q: Kodi masewera amatha kupewa kapena kubweza m’mbuyo dementia?
items.a: Palibe masewera omwe asonyezedwa kuti amachepetsa kapena kupewa dementia, ndipo masewera athu satero konse. Kuchangamutsa maganizo pamodzi ndi anthu ena kwasonyeza phindu laling’ono mu kafukufuku kwa anthu omwe ali ndi vuto la dementia loyambirira kapena lapakati, koma zimenezo n’zosiyana ndi masewera opewa matenda. Timapereka masewera kuti anthu asangalale komanso alumikizane.

Sitingatsimikizire kotheratu. Kafukufuku amalumikiza zinthu 14 za umoyo ndi kakhalidwe ndi chiwopsezo cha dementia, monga kusva bwino, kuthamanga kwambiri kwa magazi, kusachita masewera olimbitsa thupi komanso kukhala nokha popanda kucheza ndi anthu. Kusamala pa zinthu zimenezi kutha kuchepetsa chiwopsezo kwa anthu ena, koma anthu ambiri omwe amachita chilichonse moyenera amakhalabe ndi dementia. Sikulakwa kwa aliyense konse.

items.q: Kodi kusala kudya kwakanthawi n’kothandiza pa thanzi la ubongo?
items.a: Umboni wokhudza anthu ndi wochepa komanso uli pachiyambi, ndipo kafukufuku wambiri amachitika pa nyama. Kusala kudya kutha kukhala kowopsa kwa achikulire, makamaka ngati akumwa mankhwala a matenda a shuga kapena akuwonda mosayembekezereka, ndipo sikulimbikitsidwa kwa anthu omwe ali ndi vuto la dementia. Lankhulani ndi dokotala musanasinthe kadyedwe kanu.

items.q: Kodi mumatenga mfundo zilizonse zokhudza ife?
items.a: Kulibe ma akaunti kapena zotsatsa. Timagwiritsa ntchito Google Analytics powerengera alendo komanso kuona masamba omwe akuthandiza, ndipo pulogalamu yanu yofufuzira pa intaneti imakumbukira ngati mwatsegula mamvekedwe odekha. Zithunzi zomwe mumasankha pa Photo pairs sizitumizidwa konse pa intaneti. Onani chidziwitso chachinsinsi kuti mudziwe zambiri.

items.q: Kodi uwu ndi upangiri wa zachipatala?
items.a: Ayi. Golden Moments ndi yongosangalatsa komanso kupereka uthenga wamba. Pa mafunso a zaumoyo, lankhulani ndi dokotala, ndipo pakakhala zadzidzidzi imbani 998.

faq.moreHtml: Zambiri: mmene mungasewere limodzi, ngati akana, zochita pa nthawi yomwe dementia yapita patsogolo komanso kodi n’zotheka kupewa dementia?

handout.title: Masewera Aulere ndi Odekha a Anthu Omwe Ali ndi Vuto la Dementia
handout.seoTitle: Kapepala Kosindikiza: Masewera Aulere a Dementia pa Intaneti
handout.description: Kapepala kosindikiza ka tsamba limodzi ka mabanja ndi osamalira konena za masewera aulere komanso odekha a zithunzi a anthu omwe ali ndi vuto la dementia, oyenera magulu othandizana komanso mapaketi a chisamaliro.
handout.lede: Sindikizani tsambali kaamba ka gulu lothandizana, phukusi la chisamaliro kapena kumamatira pa furiji. Gwiritsani ntchito lamulo losindikiza la pulogalamu yanu yofufuzira; mindandanda ya zosankha ndi mabatani sizidzaonekera pa zosindikizazo.
handout.introHtml: Zithunzi zazikulu, mawu osavuta komanso palibe cholephera. Zaulere pa foni, tabuleti kapena kompyuta, popanda kulembetsa, popanda zotsatsa, popanda mawotchi owerengera nthawi ndipo palibe zigoli. Khalani mbali ndi mbali n’kumalandirana mwayi wosewera.
handout.restHtml:
Malangizo ochepa

  • Sankhani nthawi ya tsiku pamene munthu amene mukumusamalirayu akumva bwino kwambiri.
  • Yambani ndi magawo osavuta kwambiri. Zithunzi zinayi n’zokwanira.
  • Kambilanani za zithunzizo. Kukambirana nthawi zambiri ndi gawo labwino koposa.
  • Lekani pamene zidakali zosangalatsa. Kusiya msanga ndi chinthu chabwino.

Zinanso zopezeka patsambali

  • Zinthu zaulere zosindikiza: kufufuza mawu olembedwa mokulirapo, masamba opaka utoto, makhadi a makambirano komanso picture bingo.
  • Malingaliro a zochita pagawo lililonse, komanso malangizo osewera limodzi ndi odzisamalira nokha.

Zongofuna kusangalatsa komanso kukhala limodzi. Si upangiri wamankhwala, mayeso kapena chithandizo cha matenda. Golden Moments imafalitsidwa ndi Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.title: Za Nyumba Zosamalira Anthu, Malaibulale ndi Magulu Othandizana
organizations.seoTitle: Zochita Zaulere za Dementia za Nyumba Zosamalira Okalamba ndi Magulu
organizations.description: Momwe nyumba zosamalira okalamba, mapulogalamu a tsiku la akulu, malaibulale, mabungwe a okalamba ndi magulu othandizira amagwiritsira ntchito masewera athu aulere a dementia, komanso mawu oti tiwonjezere pa mndandanda wa zothandizira.
organizations.lede: Zonse zomwe zili patsamba lino ndi zaulere kuzigwiritsa ntchito ndi okhala nawo, mamembala ndi makasitomala, popanda akaunti, layisensi kapena malipiro. Tsamba ili likufotokoza zomwe zilipo komanso momwe mungagawire.
organizations.shortText: {name}: masewera aulere a zithunzi odekha ndi malangizo a zochita kwa anthu omwe ali ndi dementia ndi osamalira awo. Palibe kulembetsa, palibe nthawi, palibe mavoti.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) imapereka masewera {count} aulere a pa intaneti opangidwira anthu omwe ali ndi dementia, kuphatikizapo kufananiza zithunzi awiriawiri ndi zithunzi zikhalebe zooneka, puzzle yosavuta, kusanja, mawu odziwika ndi bingo ya zithunzi yokhala ndi makadi osindikizika. Palibe akaunti, malonda, nthawi kapena mavoti. Tsambali lilinso ndi malangizo a zochita olembedwa m'chinenero chosavuta a gawo lililonse la dementia, omwe amatchula National Institute on Aging ndi Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.gamesItemHtml: masewera {count} a pa intaneti omwe amayenda pa laputopu, piritsi kapena pa TV yolumikizidwa ndi kompyuta. Palibe kuikira, akaunti kapena kutsitsa. Onani masewera onse.
organizations.printablesAfter: Gwiritsani ntchito batani la Sindikiza patsamba lililonse.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Mitundu ya magulu: Bingo ya zithunzi ili ndi makadi osindikizika ndi woitana pazenera, ndipo trivia yosavuta ili ndi mafunso 50 okhala ndi mayankho osankha ndi mfundo zokambirana.
  • Malangizo a zochita a antchito ndi mabanja, malinga ndi gawo ndi mtundu wa zochita, olembedwa m'chinenero chosavuta ndi magwero. Yambani ndi malingaliro 101 a zochita kapena zochita za magulu m'nyumba zosamalira okalamba.
organizations.restHtml:
Momwe magulu amagwiritsira ntchito

  • Nyumba zosamalira okalamba ndi chisamaliro cha kukumbukira: bingo ya zithunzi kapena kumaliza mawu pa TV ya malo ogawana, ndi munthu m'modzi akukhudza chinsalu kuti gulu lonse lichite nawo.
  • Mapulogalamu a tsiku la akulu: siteshoni ya piritsi ndi Zithunzi awiriawiri zokhala ndi matailosi anayi, pa magawo afupi a munthu ndi munthu.
  • Malaibulale a boma: mapepala osindikizika a mawu obisika ndi makadi okambirana m'mabokosi a kukumbukira, ndipo tsambali likhale lolembedwa pa mapiritsi a laibulale.
  • Magulu othandizira osamalira ndi malo a zokambirana za kukumbukira: pepala limodzi losindikizika loti mabanja atenge kunyumba.
  • Zipatala ndi okonzekera kutulutsa odwala: pepalalo m'mapaketi a osamalira, kuti pakhale chinthu chodekha choti achite kunyumba kapena pambali pa bedi.

Zomwe sitichita

Masewerawa ndi a zosangalatsa ndi nthawi yocheza pamodzi. Sizizindikira, kuyesa, kuwerengera mfundo, kuchiza kapena kuchepetsa dementia, ndipo tikupempha mabungwe kuti asazifotokoze mwanjira imeneyo. Palibe malonda, ndipo masewerawa sapempha mayina, zambiri za thanzi kapena kukweza zithunzi. Tsambali limagwiritsa ntchito Google Analytics powerengera maulendo; chidziwitso chathu chachinsinsi chimafotokoza zomwe imasonkhanitsa. Zithunzi zomwe zimagwiritsidwa ntchito mu Zithunzi awiriawiri zimakhalabe mu msakatuli.

Tiwonjezereni pa mndandanda wanu wa zothandizira

Ngati muli ndi mndandanda wa zothandizira osamalira, mukulandiridwa kulumikiza ku {domain}. Mungathe kukopera kufotokozera kulikonse kwa awiriwo.
organizations.linksHtml:
Masamba othandiza omwe mungawalumikize mwachindunji: masewera aulere, zosindikizika zaulere, zochita za Alzheimer's ndi momwe mungasewere pamodzi.

Mafunso kapena kukonza

Ngati chinachake patsamba ndi cholakwika kapena chosamveka, kapena ngati zosowa za wokhala nawo sizikwaniritsidwa ndi zomwe zilipo, chonde tiuzeni pa {email}. Chonde musatumize zambiri zaumwini kapena zaumoyo za okhala nawo kapena makasitomala.

app.title: Pulogalamu ya Golden Moments
app.seoTitle: Pulogalamu ya Golden Moments ya iPhone ndi Android
app.description: Pulogalamu yaulere ya Golden Moments: kufananiza zithunzi modekha ndi matailosi anayi akuluakulu, zithunzi za banja zosungidwa pa chipangizo chanu, mapaketi a zithunzi osagwiritsa ntchito intaneti ndi popanda akaunti.
app.lede: Zonse zomwe mumakonda patsamba, mu pulogalamu yomwe imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti ndipo ingagwiritse ntchito zithunzi za banja zomwe mwasankha.
app.bodyHtml:
Yambani mophweka

Yambani ndi matailo anayi akuluakulu ndi zithunzi zodziwika bwino. Sungani zithunzi zikuonekera, kapena zibiseni ngati zikukomerani. Njira yodekha ilibe nthawi, mfundo kapena chilango. Sankhani matailo 4, 6, 8 kapena 12.

Pangani kukhala kwanu

Sankhani zithunzi za banja lanu pogwiritsa ntchito chosankhira zithunzi cha chipangizo chanu. Pulogalamuyi imasunga makope ang’onoang’ono a zithunzizo kuti azigwiritsidwa ntchito pa zochita zake. Siifufuza laibulale yanu kapena kusintha zithunzi zanu zoyambirira, ndipo imasunga zithunzi zokwana 24 mu gulu limodzi.

Ingoyang’anani limodzi

Onani chithunzi chimodzi panthawi. Mafunso osankha amakuitanani kukambirana popanda kufunsa wina kukumbukira mayina kapena kupereka yankho lolondola. Kungoyang’ana limodzi n’kokwanira.

Popanda intaneti komwe kuli kofunika

Zithunzi zoyambira ndi mapaketi onse asanu ndi atatu a zithunzi zili mkati mwa pulogalamuyi. Makope a zithunzi zomwe mwatengera amagwira ntchito popanda intaneti. Kusankha zithunzi zoyambirira zosungidwa mu iCloud kokha kungafunike intaneti.

Palibe akaunti, palibe seva yolumikiza zithunzi

Makope a zithunzi za banja amakhala mkati mwa pulogalamuyi pa chipangizo chanu. Mungathe kuchotsa makopewo popanda kuchotsa zoyambirira. Makope osungira a chipangizo angaphatikizepo deta ya pulogalamuyi. Werengani mfundo zachinsinsi za pulogalamu, ndipo thandizo la pulogalamu limakuwongolerani sitepe iliyonse.
app.disclaimer: Golden Moments ndi ya zosangalatsa komanso kukambirana pamodzi. Siizindikira, siichiza, siiletsa kapena kuyeza dementia kapena matenda a Alzheimer’s.

gamesIndex.title: Masewera Aulere a Dementia ndi Alzheimer’s Pa Intaneti
gamesIndex.description: Masewera aulere pa intaneti kwa okalamba omwe ali ndi dementia kapena Alzheimer’s: kufananiza zithunzi, zithunzithunzi zosavuta, kusanja, mawu, kujambula mitundu, bingo. Palibe kulembetsa, nthawi kapena mfundo.
gamesIndex.h1: Masewera Odekha kwa Anthu Omwe Ali ndi Dementia
gamesIndex.lede: Masewera {count} aulere oti muzisewera limodzi pa msakatuli wanu. Zithunzi zazikulu, mawu osavuta, ndipo palibe chimene chingalephereke: palibe nthawi, mfundo kapena kulembetsa.
gamesIndex.listName: Masewera odekha kwa anthu omwe ali ndi dementia
gamesIndex.byStageLede: Magawo ndi chitsogozo chochepa chabe. Tsatirani zomwe munthuyo amakonda ndi zomwe zikumukomera lero.
gamesIndex.moreHtml: Malingaliro ena kutali ndi chinsalu: Zochita 101 kwa anthu omwe ali ndi dementia, zochita ndi masewera a Alzheimer’s, masewera odekha a kukumbukira ndi zithunzithunzi.

faq.q: Ndi masewera ati omwe tiyambe nawo?
faq.a: Zithunzi ziwiri zofanana ndi matailo anayi ndi chisankho chodekha choyamba. Ngati kusankha pakati pa zithunzi kukuoneka kochulukira, yesani Pezani zomwezo ndi zithunzi ziwiri. Ngati muli gulu, yesani Bingo ya zithunzi.

faq.q: Kodi masewerawa amagwira ntchito pa iPad kapena foni?
faq.a: Inde. Masewera onse amagwira ntchito pa msakatuli pa mafoni, mapiritsi ndi makompyuta, ndipo zithunzi zimakula kuti zidzaze chinsalu. Piritsi lokhala pa choyimirira nthawi zambiri ndi lomasuka kwambiri kwa anthu awiri.

faq.q: Kodi masewerawa ndi abwino kwa munthu yemwe ali ndi Alzheimer’s?
faq.a: Inde. Anapangidwa kwa anthu okhala ndi dementia, kuphatikizapo Alzheimer’s, yomwe ndi yofala kwambiri. Zithunzi zimakhalabe zikuonekera, pali zosankha zochepa, ndipo palibe nthawi kapena mfundo, choncho masewerawa amadalira kuzindikira zinthu zodziwika bwino m’malo mokumbukira zatsopano.

faq.q: Kodi aya ndi masewera a kukumbukira a okalamba?
faq.a: Ndi masewera ofananiza ndi zithunzi omwe okalamba aliyense angasangalale nawo, koma anapangidwa kuti asayese kukumbukira: mu Zithunzi ziwiri zofanana, zithunzi zimakhala zikuoneka pamwamba pokhapokha mutasankha mwanjira ina. Buku lathu la masewera a kukumbukira kwa okalamba omwe ali ndi dementia likufotokoza momwe mungasungire masewera aliwonse a kukumbukira odekha.

faq.q: Kodi pali masewera a magulu m’nyumba yosamalira okalamba?
faq.a: Inde. Bingo ya zithunzi ili ndi makadi osindikizika ndi woyitanitsa pa chinsalu, ndipo Malizitsani mwambi ndi Makadi a kukambirana zimagwira bwino pamene zawerengedwa mokweza kwa gulu.

faq.q: Kodi pali pulogalamu ya zochita za dementia?
faq.a: Inde. Golden Moments (yolembedwa ngati "{storeName}") ndi yaulere pa App Store ndi Google Play. Imapereka kufananiza zithunzi modekha ndi matailo akuluakulu, masewera ndi zithunzi za banja zomwe mwasankha, ndi mapaketi a zithunzi omwe amagwira ntchito popanda intaneti.

faq.q: Kodi pulogalamu ya Golden Moments ndi yaulere?
faq.a: Inde. Ndi yaulere kutsitsa, popanda malonda, akaunti kapena kugula mkati mwa pulogalamu.

faq.q: Kodi pulogalamuyi imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti?
faq.a: Inde. Zithunzi zoyambira ndi mapaketi onse asanu ndi atatu a zithunzi zili mkati mwa pulogalamuyi, ndipo zithunzi za banja zimagwira ntchito popanda intaneti zikangokoperedwa mu pulogalamuyi. Kusankha chithunzi chosungidwa mu iCloud kokha kungafunike intaneti.

faq.q: Kodi ndingagwiritse ntchito zithunzi zathu za banja?
faq.a: Inde. Sankhani zithunzi ndi chosankhira zithunzi cha chipangizo chanu. Pulogalamuyi imasunga makope ang’onoang’ono pa chipangizocho kuti igwiritse ntchito pa zochita zake, siitumiza zithunzizo kwina ndipo siisintha zithunzi zoyambirira. Mukhoza kuchotsa makopewo nthawi iliyonse.

faq.q: Kodi ndi pulogalamu yophunzitsa ubongo kapena yoyesa kukumbukira?
faq.a: Ayi. Golden Moments ndi ya zosangalatsa ndi nthawi yocheza limodzi. Ilibe mavoti kapena mayeso, ndipo siizindikira, siichiza, siiteteza kapena kuyesa dementia kapena matenda a Alzheimer’s.

gameFaqYes.q: Kodi pali mtundu wa masewerawa mu pulogalamu?
gameFaqYes.a: Inde. Pulogalamu yaulere ya Golden Moments ya iPhone, iPad ndi Android ili ndi masewera omwewo ofananiza zithunzi mofatsa, imatha kugwiritsa ntchito zithunzi za banja zomwe mwasankha, ndipo imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti. Palibe akaunti, malonda kapena mavoti.

gameFaqNo.q: Kodi pali mtundu wa masewerawa mu pulogalamu?
gameFaqNo.a: Osati masewerawa. Pulogalamu yaulere ya Golden Moments ya iPhone, iPad ndi Android ili ndi kufananiza zithunzi mofatsa ndi matailosi akulu, komanso zithunzi za banja zomwe mwasankha, ndipo imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti. Masewerawa adzakhalabe aulere pano, mu msakatuli wanu.
